mapper.insert: insert into "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" ( quotation_id, username, status, total_price ) values (#{quotation_id}, #{username}, #{status}, #{total_price})

insert into "interviewworks_schema"."quotation_items" ( quotation_id, product_id, quantity, price, unit_percent, unit_price ) values (#{quotation_id}, #{product_id}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{unit_percent}, #{unit_price})
mapper.select: select userdata_details.username, quotations.quotation_id, quotations.status from "interviewworks_schema"."userdata_details" userdata_details inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations on userdata_details.username = quotations.username where userdata_details.is_active = '1' and userdata_details.order_item = #{orderItem} and userdata_details.username = #{username}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM "interviewworks_schema"."quotation_items" qi WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" ud WHERE qi.quotation_id = ud.quotation_id and ud.quotation_id = #{quotation_id} )
mapper.select: select quotations.quotation_id, userdata_details.username, quotations.status, quotation_items.quantity, quotation_items.price, quotation_items.quantity * quotation_items.price as sum_price, products.products_name, products.description from "interviewworks_schema"."userdata_details" userdata_details inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations on userdata_details.username = quotations.username inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotation_items" quotation_items on quotations.quotation_id = quotation_items.quotation_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."products" products on quotation_items.product_id = products.product_id where userdata_details.is_active = '1' and userdata_details.tracking_number is null and userdata_details.username = #{username} order by quotations.quotation_id desc
select products.product_id, products.stock from "interviewworks_schema"."products" products where product_id = #{product_id} order by products.product_id
mapper.insert: insert into "interviewworks_schema"."shipments" ( order_id, status, prefix, date_part, serial, tracking_number ) values (#{order_id}, #{status}, #{prefix}, #{date_part}, #{serial}, #{tracking_number})
insert into "interviewworks_schema"."payments" ( order_id, amount, status, payments_method ) values (#{order_id}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{payments_method})
mapper.update:
update "interviewworks_schema"."payments"
amount = #{amount},
status = #{status},
payments_method = #{payments_method},
where order_id = #{order_id}
mapper.select: select shipments.tracking_number as tracking_number, products.product_id as product_id, products.stock as stock, quotation_items.quantity as quantity from "interviewworks_schema"."shipments" shipments inner join "interviewworks_schema"."orders" orders on shipments.order_id = orders.order_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations on orders.quotation_id = quotations.quotation_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotation_items" quotation_items on quotations.quotation_id = quotation_items.quotation_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."products" products on quotation_items.product_id = products.product_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."payments" payments on shipments.order_id = payments.order_id where payments.status = 'paid' and shipments.status in ('shipped', 'delivered') and orders.status = 'confirmed' and quotations.status = 'accepted' and shipments.tracking_number = #{tracking_number} order by shipments.order_id

select concat(product_id, ':', quantity) as order_item from "interviewworks_schema".shipments shipments inner join "interviewworks_schema"."orders" orders on shipments.order_id = orders.order_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations on orders.quotation_id = quotations.quotation_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotation_items" quotation_items on orders.quotation_id = quotation_items.quotation_id where shipments.order_id = #{order_id}
